Composition & Indication

Empagliflozin 25mg — 30 Tablets (Generic for Jardiance®) contains Empagliflozin 25 mg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 30 Tablets at the official 25mg strength. The standard indication is the management of type 2 diabetes management, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Empagliflozin 25mg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.

Prescription Required. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1). Please consult your healthcare provider before use.
